3D asset credits

Destiny Class Generation Ship - USS Eldridge II, by Vaportrash
https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/destiny-class-generation-ship-uss-eldridge-ii-909dfe6b06e842d79e7f2b085738822f
CC BY 4.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Adapted for this experience through mesh simplification, relighting, and a rendered fallback.

What do a seashell and a galaxy share in common?, by Salvatore Orlando
https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/what-do-a-seashell-and-a-galaxy-share-in-common-d37e1b14da8a46709ed46a2e208eeed9
CC BY 4.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Adapted from the model's emissive galaxy and registered golden-ratio diagram planes, compressed and animated for the web.

Experiment Perspective Loop FBX GLB web, by IZ.MdVerz
https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/experiment-perspective-loop-fbx-glb-web-81b84dffaf6d41ba9da5dc4105c9a543
CC BY 4.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Stair mesh extracted from the supplied GLB, relit in brass and filmed with a scroll-driven camera.
